ideas: {"ideas": [{"idea_id": "1", "name": "Potaje tradicional de garbanzos con espinacas", "one_line": "Estofado clásico español de garbanzos con espinacas, ajo, cebolla y pimentón, adaptado para batch cooking.", "main_ingredients": ["canned chickpeas", "spinach", "onion", "garlic", "crushed tomatoes", "smoked paprika"], "rough_macros": {"kcal": 440, "protein_g": 30, "carbs_g": 55, "fat_g": 10}, "image_prompt": "A bowl of traditional Spanish chickpea and spinach stew with a rich paprika broth."}, {"idea_id": "2", "name": "Potaje de garbanzos y espinacas con toque de huevo", "one_line": "Estofado de garbanzos y espinacas con huevo cocido picado, inspirado en la receta tradicional española.", "main_ingredients": ["canned chickpeas", "spinach", "onion", "garlic", "eggs", "cumin"], "rough_macros": {"kcal": 460, "protein_g": 33, "carbs_g": 48, "fat_g": 14}, "image_prompt": "A hearty bowl of chickpea and spinach stew topped with sliced hard-boiled eggs."}, {"idea_id": "3", "name": "Potaje de garbanzos con espinacas y majao de almendras", "one_line": "Guiso de garbanzos y espinacas espesado con un majao tradicional de ajo, comino y pan tostado.", "main_ingredients": ["canned chickpeas", "spinach", "onion", "tomato", "garlic", "cumin"], "rough_macros": {"kcal": 435, "protein_g": 28, "carbs_g": 52, "fat_g": 12}, "image_prompt": "A thick chickpea and spinach stew served in a rustic earthenware bowl."}, {"idea_id": "4", "name": "Potaje express de garbanzos, espinacas y tomate", "one_line": "Versión rápida de garbanzos con espinacas en base de tomate especiado y un toque de comino.", "main_ingredients": ["canned chickpeas", "spinach", "crushed tomatoes", "onion", "garlic", "smoked paprika"], "rough_macros": {"kcal": 420, "protein_g": 29, "carbs_g": 54, "fat_g": 9}, "image_prompt": "Close-up of a vibrant tomato-based chickpea and spinach stew garnished with herbs."}]}
recipe: {"idea_id": "1", "title": "Potaje tradicional de garbanzos con espinacas", "servings": 6, "prep_time_min": 40, "ingredients": [{"name": "canned chickpeas", "grams_per_serving": 330, "units_per_serving": 0, "storage": "keeps", "pantry": false, "dry": false}, {"name": "spinach", "grams_per_serving": 250, "units_per_serving": 0, "storage": "fresh", "pantry": false, "dry": false}, {"name": "onion", "grams_per_serving": 90, "units_per_serving": 0, "storage": "fresh", "pantry": false, "dry": false}, {"name": "garlic", "grams_per_serving": 30, "units_per_serving": 0, "storage": "fresh", "pantry": false, "dry": false}, {"name": "crushed tomatoes", "grams_per_serving": 130, "units_per_serving": 0, "storage": "keeps", "pantry": false, "dry": false}, {"name": "smoked paprika", "grams_per_serving": 4, "units_per_serving": 0, "storage": "keeps", "pantry": true, "dry": true}, {"name": "extra virgin olive oil", "grams_per_serving": 10, "units_per_serving": 0, "storage": "keeps", "pantry": true, "dry": false}, {"name": "salt", "grams_per_serving": 3, "units_per_serving": 0, "storage": "keeps", "pantry": true, "dry": true}, {"name": "black pepper", "grams_per_serving": 1, "units_per_serving": 0, "storage": "keeps", "pantry": true, "dry": true}], "steps": ["Pica finamente la cebolla y los dientes de ajo.", "En una cazuela grande, calienta el aceite de oliva y sofríe la cebolla y el ajo a fuego medio hasta que estén tiernos.", "Añade el pimentón ahumado y remueve rápidamente durante unos segundos para que no se queme.", "Incorpora el tomate triturado y cocina durante 5 minutos hasta que reduzca ligeramente.", "Agrega los garbanzos enjuagados y escurridos junto con las espinacas frescas y mezcla bien.", "Cocina a fuego lento durante 15 minutos para que los sabores se integren.", "Deja enfriar por completo, divide en 6 porciones y guarda en recipientes herméticos para la semana."]}
